programme.title: 2025 Elite Season
programme.sub-title: 2025 Elite at Lake Okeechobee Live Day 4
programme.desc: Championship day coverage of the Champion Power Equipment Bassmaster Elite on Lake Okeechobee located in Clewiston, Florida. Follow along as the top anglers in the world battle to see who is crowned the Bassmaster Elite Champion on Lake Okeechobee.

programme.title: 2025 Elite Season
programme.sub-title: 2025 Elite at Lake Okeechobee Weigh-in Day 4
programme.desc: Join Dave Mercer and Lisa Talmadge as the top anglers in the world weigh in their 5 largest bass at Lake Okeechobee in Clewiston, Florida. The 10 anglers remaining compete for the top spot and $100,000 in the second event of the 2025 Progressive Bassmaster Elite season.

programme.title: 2026 Elite Series Season Preview
programme.desc: Bass fishing’s biggest stage has been set for 2026 with the return of the Progressive Bassmaster Elite Series, featuring a dynamic schedule that will test the world’s best anglers on some of the nation’s most storied waters.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Kyoya Fujitia
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance for the 8th stop of the 2023 Bassmaster Elite Series season, watch Kyoya Fujita take the title at Lake Champlain for the first B.A.S.S. win of his career. The young Japanese prodigy stormed to 5 Top 10's in his Rookie season.
